item.title: 5.0.3-beta.7
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.0.3-beta.7 – Finder Clicks That Feel Native! 🗂️🖱️

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Finder Follows Your Dock’s Click Behavior: Clicking Finder in an ExtraDock dock now honors that dock’s frontmost action — None, Minimize, Hide or Cycle — instead of always jumping to a folder!
  • No More Dead Clicks Between Docks: Alternating between the macOS Dock and ExtraDock could minimize, reopen or do nothing at random when the desktop was active but no Finder window was open — every click now reads Finder’s live state!
  • Your Window Comes Back: Minimizing Finder from a dock and clicking again restores that exact window instead of opening a duplicate!
  • New Finder Window Command: Right-click the Finder widget or a Live Dock Finder icon for the standard New Finder Window item — the widget opens your configured folder, the app icon opens Home!
  • Reserved Space Survives Keyboard Tiling: Snapping a window to a half with a keyboard shortcut or window manager now settles inside your reserved dock space, even with Active on Drag turned off!

🚀 What’s Next?

Finder now clicks like the real thing everywhere — if any app still activates the wrong way, send a report and it goes straight to the top of the list!

Thank you for helping test ExtraDock 5! Your feedback drives every improvement we make. 💙

ExtraDock 5.0.2 – Battery Widget & Bars That Fit! 🔋📐

✨ What's New

  • Bluetooth Battery Widget: See the charge level of your AirPods, Magic Keyboard, Mouse, Trackpad, controllers and other Bluetooth accessories right in your dock!
  • Auto Bar Thickness: Bars now grow and shrink to hug your icons by default, so big icons never overflow — or pick any thickness yourself to pin it!
  • Custom Icon Size: A new Custom option gives you an exact 20–128 pt slider for icon size!
  • Dock Actions Everywhere: Right-click any dock item or drag handle for an ExtraDock menu with Hide Dock, Pin to Edge, Copy/Paste Settings and more!
  • Drag Handle on Hover: Hover a floating dock for a second and a compact move handle appears — even with the permanent handle turned off!
  • Smooth First Appearance: Docks now fade and scale in gently when they first appear!

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • No More Jitter: Floating docks parked next to the macOS Dock stay perfectly still!
  • Dragging Icons Just Moves Icons: Dragging an icon no longer moves the whole dock — only empty bar space does!
  • Reserve Dock Space Self-Heals: No more toggling it off and on to get your space back!
  • Item Names Show on Hover: Hover labels and "Always show label" work reliably again, with no extra permissions needed!
  • No Startup Flash: Docks appear directly at their saved position instead of jumping there a moment later!
  • Divider Is Compact Again: Back to its original slim footprint, with Side spacing that actually changes it!
  • Trash Prompt Stays Visible: The Empty Trash confirmation can no longer hide behind the Manager window!
  • No Stuck Bouncing: Launcher apps can't leave an icon bouncing forever!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you to everyone who tested the 5.0.2 betas — your feedback drives every improvement we make. 💙
